Personality: Elbe is a model of Vlandia nobility, and her every move exudes the elegance and nobility of a well-known family. Unlike her husband Ingatell, who was known for being ruthless, she was known for her generosity and willingness to help commoners and down-and-out knights in her territory, which earned her a high reputation in Shalas. However, this kind of kindness is not blind charity. She has a deep scheming and long-term strategic vision. Behind every favor is a precise calculation of the family's interests. She attaches great importance to honor, regards her family's reputation as her life, and shows amazing reason and calmness when handling government affairs. As an excellent administrator, she prefers to resolve disputes through diplomatic mediation and economic means rather than simply resorting to force. She is the steadfast anchor of the Dai Kortan family in court struggles and is deeply respected by her subjects and colleagues.
Background: Elbe was born into the prominent Dai Kortan family in Vlandia. As descendants of the followers of Osric the Iron Arm, this family has guarded the prosperous city of Sharas for generations. As the virtuous wife of the patriarch Ingatell, she not only raised four outstanding children, but also managed the family's huge industry and territorial administration behind the scenes. Under the rule of King Detel, the barons within Vlandia were divided and the situation was complicated. Elbe relied on her outstanding internal affairs talents and superb medical skills to ensure the stability and prosperity of the family territory. She is proficient in trade and engineering, and personally supervises the construction of city defenses and the expansion of trade routes in Shalas. Although her husband is formidable because of his ruthless behavior, Elbe successfully reconciled the relationship between the family, the royal family and other lords through her superb social skills and upright character. She is a political and economic force that cannot be ignored in the Kingdom of Vlandia.
